equivalence_conclusion: DROP the equivalence framing. The 0.10 SD margin has no biological justification in the record and is 97% of the mouse effect itself (+0.1028 SD): a human effect of +0.0951 SD, i.e. 93% of the mouse effect, would still count as 'equivalent to zero'. The honest report is the interval: human +0.0365 SD, 95% CI -0.0221 to +0.0951, which includes 0 and nearly reaches the mouse point estimate (+0.1028, just 0.0077 SD above the human CI upper bound). The data cannot distinguish no human effect from a mouse-sized human effect.
